$comment: [X4.13] HashiCorp Terraform MCP attach spec. Tier-2 VERIFIED-PUBLISHER (publisher `hashicorp` — official Terraform MCP server from github.com/hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server; X1.x evidence; first of the 6 candidate set). Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). Go server shipped as the Docker image hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server (stdio default); public Registry tools need no auth, HCP/TFE workspace tools need TFE_TOKEN. CC0-1.0.
title: HashiCorp Terraform Registry & Cloud
description: Search the Terraform Registry for providers, modules, and policies, and manage HCP Terraform / Enterprise workspaces via the official Terraform MCP server.

env_vars.name: TFE_TOKEN
env_vars.description: HCP Terraform / Terraform Enterprise API token. Only needed for the workspace and private-registry tools; the public Registry tools work without it. Pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

env_vars.name: TFE_ADDRESS
env_vars.description: HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise address (default https://app.terraform.io).

env_vars.name: TFE_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
env_vars.description: Set to `true` to skip HCP/TFE TLS verification. Development/testing only.

env_vars.name: ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS
env_vars.description: Set to `true` to enable mutating workspace tools that require explicit approval (create/update/delete workspace, runs). Off by default.

auth.recipe: no credentials needed for the public Terraform Registry tools; for HCP Terraform / Enterprise workspace tools set TFE_TOKEN (and TFE_ADDRESS for self-hosted TFE).

sample_tools.name: search_providers
sample_tools.summary: Search the Terraform Registry for providers matching a query.

sample_tools.name: get_provider_details
sample_tools.summary: Get documentation and details for a Terraform provider.

sample_tools.name: search_modules
sample_tools.summary: Search the Terraform Registry for modules.

sample_tools.name: get_module_details
sample_tools.summary: Get details for a Terraform Registry module.

sample_tools.name: search_policies
sample_tools.summary: Search the Terraform Registry for Sentinel policies.

sample_tools.name: list_workspaces
sample_tools.summary: List HCP Terraform / Enterprise workspaces (requires TFE_TOKEN).

known_limitations: Public Terraform Registry tools (providers, modules, policies) need no auth; HCP Terraform / Terraform Enterprise workspace tools require an API token (TFE_TOKEN) and TFE_ADDRESS.
Distributed as a Docker image (hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server) — Docker must be installed and running; a Go binary is also installable from source.
Workspace mutation tools (create/update/delete workspace, runs) are gated behind ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS=true and are off by default.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): delete_workspace is flagged in `destructive_tools` (and additionally gated behind ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS); blocked when the trust policy sets allowDestructive:false.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `hashicorp-terraform`: { command: docker, args: [run, -i, --rm, hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server] } (add -e TFE_TOKEN with env for HCP/TFE tools).
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `hashicorp-terraform`, command `docker run -i --rm hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server`; set TFE_TOKEN in the env to enable HCP/TFE tools.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `hashicorp-terraform` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview); supply TFE_TOKEN via inputs for HCP/TFE tools.
